question: Who among the following won the Dada Saheb Phalke Award in 2020 for his documentary ‘Chi Lupo’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kezang D Thongdok**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kezang D. Thongdok of Arunachal Pradesh won the Dada Saheb Phalke Award 2020 for his short documentary "Chi Lupo."**
 
• Chi Lupo, documented by Kezang D Thongdok is **a short documentary on honey hunting.**
 
• **Chi Lupo depicts the honey hunting tradition prevalent in the Shertukpen community in which "chi" means honey while "lipo" means hunter.**
 
• This age-old tradition of honey hunting is slowly dying out with each passing day.
 
• To keep alive this indigenous practice of honey hunting, Kezang de Thongdok documented the **centuries-old tradition of honey hunting.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Kasinathuni Viswanath**

 
 
• Kasinathuni Viswanath** is a famous south Indian film actor, writer, and director.**
 
 
 
• **Bommireddy Nagi Reddy**
 
 
• **​**Bommi Nagi Reddy **was an Indian film producer and director mainly in Telugu cinema**. 
 
 
 
• **Akkineni Nageswara Rao**
 
 
• **​**Akkineni Nageswara Rao** was an Indian actor and producer, known for his work predominantly in Telugu cinema.**
